title: docs-notes
subHeroTitle: A unified document and file hub integrated with your workspace
subHeroDesc: Meet Motion. Write structured documents, upload reference files, collaborate with your team in real time, and link everything directly to your tasks and active sprint state.

sections.title: A rich interactive document and file canvas
sections.desc: Write documents with typographic styling and inline widgets, and keep uploaded files side-by-side using structured directories supported by secure cloud uploads.

gridItems.title: Rich Block Canvas
gridItems.desc: Write comfortably using text, headings, bullet lists, block quotes, and code blocks built on a customizable TipTap editor with crash protection auto-saving to localStorage.

gridItems.title: Infinite Nested Trees
gridItems.desc: Nest pages infinitely (e.g. subpages Q3 Strategy inside Marketing) to build structured team wikis, knowledge bases, and deep subpage directories.

gridItems.title: Two-Level Folder Structure
gridItems.desc: Group multiple pages and external files side-by-side inside client or project folders supporting up to two levels of nested directories.

gridItems.title: S3 Cloud Uploads & Previews
gridItems.desc: Upload PDFs, Word docs, slide decks, images, and videos directly to Amazon S3, complete with formats scanning and color-coded type tag previews.

sections.title: Real-time collaboration with secure space access
sections.desc: Co-edit documents simultaneously with team members, manage granular access permissions, and sync edits bi-directionally with your Notion workspace.

gridItems.title: WebSocket Concurrent Edits
gridItems.desc: Edit concurrently with teammates in real-time, backed by active cursor tracking, text comments, selection threads, and visual 28-day analytics.

gridItems.title: AI Writing Partner
gridItems.desc: Highlight paragraphs and ask the AI helper to stream rewrites, translations, or summaries directly onto your document canvas in real-time.

gridItems.title: 2-Way Notion Integration
gridItems.desc: Connect Notion via 1-click OAuth to import/export documents and auto-convert blocks bi-directionally using Last-Write-Wins updates.

gridItems.title: Granular Permissions
gridItems.desc: Control visibility using Private invite-only mode, Space access, or web public links, with roles like Full Access, Can Edit, or Can View.

capabilitiesDesc: Forget isolated documentation silos. Motion integrates rich-text block editing directly to active tasks and space permissions.
checklistDesc: Unify product specifications, team guides, and meeting transcripts inside one integrated knowledge canvas.
checklistItems: TipTap Block Editor: Write using structured elements (text, headings, lists, quotes, tables) with background auto-save and local localStorage memory backup.,
Directories Folders & Files: Create up to two levels of nested folders, uploading PDFs, slide decks, and media side-by-side to secure Amazon S3 with visual previews.,
Granular Security Permissions: Secure pages using Private invite-only settings, open access to team Spaces, or publish secure read-only public web links.,
Native Notion API Integration: Authenticate with Notion in one click to import/export documents and sync edits bidirectionally using Last-Write-Wins conflict resolution.,
WebSocket & AI Collaboration: Edit in real-time with concurrent cursor tracks, use streaming AI copy generators, leave block-specific comments, and review 28-day view charts.
